Subject: EMEA/APAC commit check-in — EOD update required

Team —

Quick FYI and ask: finance needs a clean commit rollup for EMEA and APAC by EOD Friday so we can finalize the Q2 forecast. Please do the following today or tomorrow morning at the latest:

- Update stage and close dates for any deals you intend to commit in Salesforce (use the Commit stage).
- Add a single line entry in the shared Google sheet (link below) for all active commits with expected ARR and signed/expected sign date.
- Mark any deals that are contingent on procurement/legal with the tag: "Hold — Legal/PO" in the notes column.

Attached: commit_template.csv (use this to paste into the sheet if helpful).

If you have outstanding redlines or SOC/controls asks blocking signature, flag them in the sheet and CC the external contact so Laura can triage. I will consolidate mid-Friday and push the rollup to Finance.

Thanks —
Karthik

If legal can fast-track the EuroTech redlines (Laura, looping you), we should be able to move from Hold -> Commit by Friday.

Thanks,
